comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted OER supplies named weighted courses and longitudinal lines closing 60+60+60. Required regular study totals 157.5 EC and genuine added profiling totals 22.5 EC (15 EC in year two and 7.5 EC in year three). The third-year Veterinaire professional line is 10.5 EC including the 7.5-EC thesis, which is counted once and not added again through the 30-EC profile description. At least 7.5 EC of profiling must be outside the Veterinary faculty.
